messages:
ajay: Planning a small traffic bump for the model-serving change today. Target window 18:30-19:30 UTC. Will do staged increments: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Waiting 8m between steps for metrics to settle.

lucy: I can own the smoke checks for the first two steps (0.5% and 2%). I'll confirm latency p50/p95 and error-rate.

sam: I'll be watching cost and throughput; will look for any spike in GPU queue length. Post-check I'll give go/no-go.

maria: Oncall dashboard links? also who has rollback creds?

ajay: Dashboards: https://dash.redwood/serving/traffic, perf: https://dash.redwood/serving/perf. Rollback is `redwoodctl rollout cancel --deployment model-serving-prod` (infra role required). ish has the infra role.

ishaan: I have rollback creds. I'll be ready to run the cancel command and flip feature flag if needed.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by ajay at 2026-03-18T18:30:00Z. Staged increments configured in release plan ID rlp_7832.

ajay: Quick checklist for reviewers: 1) config validation passed on k8s manifests 2) smoke tests green in staging 3) canary artifact checksum matches prod registry 4) alert rules attached to rollout policy.

lucy: Added a short smoke checklist I will run: - send 50 inference requests to canary path - assert success rate >= 99% - p95 latency < 420ms - no increase in OOM events - KV cache hit ratio stable

sam: Signal thresholds for abort: error-rate increase > 0.5 percentage points sustained for 2 windows, p95 > 2x baseline, or GPU queue > 80% for >4m. If any trigger, mark rollback and ping infra-oncall.

maria: I'll coordinate customer impact comms if we abort. Also leaving a note for docs to freeze config changes during rollout.

ajay: For cohort selection we're using a geo-randomized sample: RU/DE/UK only for first 10%. Then broaden to NA for 50%. No mobile-only cohorts this wave.

lucy: I'll run the smoke harness after each step and post a short summary like "step 2: pass, p95 380ms, err 0.04%".

sam: tagging monitors to watch: svc-errors, inference-latency-p95, gpu-queue-length, prefix-cache-hit.

ishaan: I'll standby for rollback and cloud infra changes. If we need a quick rollback toggle, use feature flag `ff/model-serving-v2-enable` -> set to false.

ajay: Small note: keep change window quiet (no other infra deploys). If anything else scheduled, message here.

lucy: LGTM for the plan. I'll start at 18:30 UTC and post results. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll be on call during the window. ping me with results or if you want me to execute any infra ops.

maria: Thanks team — I'll draft a short post-mortem template in case we need it.

ajay: OK launching now in 10m. If you don't see updates here within 10m assume nothing happened and ping me.

deploy-bot: rollout started: rlp_7832 step 1 -> 0.5% at 2026-03-18T18:30:12Z.

lucy: step 1: quick smoke: success rate 100%, p95 350ms, err 0.0% — proceeding to 2% in 8m.

sam: step 1 metrics look clean from my side. No queue spikes.

ajay: Thanks. Proceeding to step 2 as planned.

-- end of thread --
